nature: PROSPECTIVE held-out cohort (new seed 20261023, 150 queries, fresh data, 30% ON clauses with one-side conjuncts). Generated from the seed and frozen by git blob SHA before any Spark, Coq or SQLite execution of these queries.
checker: check3 / check3_sound in QueryProofDeepWide.v (self-contained, axiom-free): grammar adds IsNull, IN over literals and width-bounded Add; one unified INNER-join law (WHERE, ON and input-filter conjuncts redistributed into input filters and ON, with implied IsNotNull, also through an unchanged attribute-only Project); a LEFT OUTER right-side ON law; V16 Filter, Combine, Project and LEFT OUTER WHERE forms
printer: tools/queryproof_v19_wide_20261022/print_terms_v19.py (Add is modelled in ANSI mode: TreeNode JSON erases evalContext)
spark: official pyspark==4.2.0 wheel with the disposable AST trace overlay
unit: one effective rule event (old != new) in the captured Catalyst trace

definitions.UNKNOWN: the printer cannot express the event; counts as NOT accepted
definitions.coverage(rule): ACCEPTED / all effective events of that rule (UNKNOWN in the denominator)
definitions.differential: as in V18 (exact kernel terms -> SQL -> SQLite, 40 random NULL- and duplicate-rich databases per pair), extended with IS NULL, IN and +

H0a_no_accepted_event_differs.statement: No ACCEPTED event differs in the SQLite differential.

H0b_evaluable_fraction.statement: At least 80% of ACCEPTED events are evaluable by the differential.

H1_no_invalid_mutant_accepted.statement: No VALIDATED_WRONG or ILL_SCOPED mutant is accepted.

H5_oracle_agreement.statement: Spark and SQLite query result bags agree on every query both engines execute.

reported_without_prediction: exact SQL overlap with the V17 and V18 cohorts
reporting: All counts are reported whether or not thresholds are met. Failures and infrastructure reruns stay on record.
